Shot difficulty vs shot making

Source: R/shotmaking.R
plot_shot_making.Rd

Each player is a point: x = how hard their shots are (expected FG%, reversed so harder is to the right), y = how much better or worse than expected they finish them. Point size = attempts. The four corners have a story (tough-shot makers, efficient finishers, ...), which is written on the plot.

Usage

plot_shot_making(
  sm,
  label = "player",
  highlight = NULL,
  n_label = 8,
  min_attempts = 200,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL
)

Arguments

sm

Output of shot_making().

label

Column with names.

highlight

Names to colour and always label.

n_label

Also label the n_label most extreme players.

min_attempts

Drop players with fewer attempts.

title, subtitle, caption

Labels.
